name: Little Coal River Campground
skip_reason: Not a Big Earl's duplicate - settled, so a later pass need not redo it - but fails the live-web-presence rule. DISTINCT FROM id 1200: different phones (this one 304-369-1951, reservations 304-687-7672, vs Big Earl's 304-756-4189), different site counts (17 vs 14), 1.0 km apart, and no source anywhere mentions a rename; two small campgrounds that close is normal in Hatfield-McCoy ATV country, and a Dec 2021 Dyrt review places this one 'across the main highway from the Waterways water park'. WHY SKIPPED ANYWAY: the operator domain littlecoalrivercampground.com is PARKED and advertised for sale; the RoverPass listing is UNCLAIMED (a stale-rate trap, not a booking channel); Campendium flags the location 'No Longer Maintained' with zero reviews; and the newest firsthand review of any kind is 2021-12-28. The WV Tourism listing still describes 17 RV sites with water/sewer/20-30-50-amp, a renovated bathhouse, a cabin and a 36-ft rental trailer, but it cites the now-dead domain, so it is stale corroboration rather than evidence of current operation. NOT confirmed closed - phone either number to settle it.
